legend: The tumour cells with granular cytoplasm are infiltrative in the breast parenchyma.
The tumour cells are large, with abundant granular and pale pink cytoplasm, inconspicuous cytoplasmic borders, and bland nuclei.
Immunohistochemical staining highlights the infiltrative tumour cells, which show strong and diffuse positivity for S100.
A partially circumscribed nodular mass is seen in the subcutaneous adipose tissue.

legend: The mass comprises solid sheets and nests of cells with ample granular pink cytoplasm and variably vesicular nuclei without distinct nucleoli.
Immunohistochemistry for S100 shows diffuse positive staining of the tumour cells.

A partially circumscribed nodular mass is seen in the subcutaneous adipose tissue, comprising solid sheets and nests of cells with ample granular pink cytoplasm and variably vesicular nuclei without distinct nucleoli. Some tumour cells contain cytoplasmic pink small globules. Rare mitoses are seen, no necrosis is present. No breast epithelial elements are seen. Immunohistochemistry for S100 shows diffuse positive staining of the tumour cells. No reactivity is observed for epithelial markers.
